name: Kyub sa Capiztahan 2025

venue.name: Robinsons Roxas
venue.address: HQ92+PF5, Immaculate Heart of Mary Avenue, Pueblo de Panay, Brgy, Roxas City, Capiz

information: Welcome to **Kyub sa Capiztahan 2025**! The 2nd WCA competition in the city of Roxas, Capiz celebrating CAPIZtahan 2025, a cultural and food festival commemorating the founding anniversary of the province of Capiz. *PLEASE TAKE NOTE: The schedule is not fixed and may run ahead or behind depending on the competition flow that day. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it.*
